definitions.gloss: to be fed up with; to lose patience with; to be disgusted with
definitions.explanation: To completely lose one's goodwill or patience toward someone due to repeated disappointment. Implies that one has reached the end of their tolerance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{愛想|あいそ}を{尽|つ}かされた。
examples.english: She got fed up with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}って→約束を破る：20639_yakusokuwoyaburu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{愛想|あいそ}を{尽|つ}かした。
examples.english: He kept breaking promises and never changed, so I gave up on him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{愛想|あいそ}を{尽|つ}かして、⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{辞|や}めていった。
examples.english: The employees lost patience with the company's handling of things and quit one after another.

notes:
Literally 'to exhaust one's goodwill.' ⟦{愛想|あいそ}→愛想：12699_aiso⟧ means friendliness or amiability, and {尽|つ}かす means to exhaust or use up completely. When someone {愛想|あいそ}を{尽|つ}かす, they have run out of all patience and goodwill.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The person one is fed up with is marked by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{愛想|あいそ}を{尽|つ}かす. The passive form {愛想|あいそ}を{尽|つ}かされる ('to have someone give up on you') is very common.

FORMS:
- {愛想|あいそう}を{尽|つ}かす — variant pronunciation with long vowel
- ⟦{愛想|あいそ}→愛想：12699_aiso⟧{尽|づ}かし — the noun form meaning 'being fed up'

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うんざりする→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧ — to be fed up, sick of; more casual, can apply to situations as well as people
- {見限|みかぎ}る — to give up on someone; implies abandoning someone as hopeless
- ⟦{呆|あき}れる→呆れる：06720_akireru⟧ — to be exasperated; focuses on shock/disbelief at someone's behavior
